$comment: M189a (D974): one verdict per reached survivor of the census's runtime mutants, held to tflw-acceptance/mutation/reach.json by `npm run verify:reach-verdicts` in both directions. `not-asserted` = a plant runs through it and its known answer does not depend on the result (the dogfood is shallow there; a row is filed per family in testFlow/REVIEW_FINDINGS.md). `out-of-reach-by-design` = the result is visible only where the acceptance roster does not look, or is graded by a reference gate the census does not run (D751, D846). Read 2026-09-13 against the reach measured the same day over 106 plants at tflw main@29dfa0a. Re-read 2026-09-14 against `M190`'s re-census (the same 106 plants, tflw main@46750a0): 42 reached survivors again, 41 verdicts carried unchanged and one added (`threshold-scope-falls-back-to-the-whole-histogram`, added to the registry after the previous census and reached in this one).

ambiguity-count-from-a-second-query.why: the ambiguity message when a locator matches several elements: ten plants run through the formatter on a page where the locator was unambiguous, so the count and the list are never read; a plant would need a deliberately ambiguous locator and read the sentence back

ambiguity-list-without-discriminators.why: the per-candidate discriminator in the ambiguity list — same ten plants, same unambiguous pages; no known answer here has ever been a sentence about several matches

api-wait-ignores-its-own-budget.why: C67, C70, C71 and C72 run through the api-side budget line; C72 (`step:wait`) asserts the wait re-issues until its condition holds and stops — never that a `timeout wait` clause is the number that bounded it

applicability-collapses-to-pass.why: reached by C80's security assertion; rule applicability and the counts line are the security reference gates' subject (C57, verify:security-acceptance, D751)

array-body-flattened-to-an-object.why: 48 plants serialise an inline body here and none of them writes an array body, so the spread into an object never has an array to flatten; the wire is where it shows and the arrival server can echo a body

assertion-diagnosis-never-fires.why: the nearest-matches diagnosis on a locator that resolved to nothing: every browser plant runs through it and reads the element that answered, never the sentence a miss produces; C13-C22 grade which element answered, C108 grades which web base a file is at home under

backoff-hold-kind.why: a module-level constant every plant loads; the D17 back-off diagnostic it names lands in the report as `backOff`, and C45 (`step:hold`) grades the arrival curve, not whether the run reported backing off — a `hold N users` against a path slow enough to back off is the fixture

blocked-port-hint-reads-undicis-prose.why: C6, C7, C95, C106 and C107 all pass through the hint; the mutant gates it on undici's own `bad port` text, which is what undici says today, so the two builds print the same sentence — the difference exists only under a future undici, which no fixture can install

browser-close-rethrow.why: 35 plants close a browser through these two lines and every launch succeeded; the mutant differs only after a launch failure, and its difference is the process exit status — neither is something an acceptance plant provokes or reads

comparison-coerces-operands.why: 37 plants compare with `is less than`/`is greater than` and every operand is a number, so the guard against `null`/`false`/`[]` is executed and never tripped; C60-C66 grade the seven matchers on values that fit them

config-files-resolve-against-cwd.why: 79 plants resolve config file references and every grader runs `tflw` with its cwd at the config directory, where cwd-relative and config-relative are the same path; C106/C107 (`cert`/`key`) would need one run from elsewhere

csrf-attached-to-safe-methods.why: 82 plants run through the CSRF attachment and none declares a session with a CSRF header, so the verb condition never has a token to withhold; the arrival server records request headers, so a session fixture against it can read the wire

diagnosis-ignores-the-resolved-element.why: the nearest-matches diagnosis on a locator that resolved to nothing: every browser plant runs through it and reads the element that answered, never the sentence a miss produces; C13-C22 grade which element answered, C108 grades which web base a file is at home under

floor-filters-findings-not-rules.why: reached by C80's security assertion; the severity floor's denominator is graded by the security reference gates (D751)

imports-drop-body.why: 17 plants resolve imports through this line; what the dropped body costs is `TF044` across a file boundary, a check diagnostic, and check diagnostics are graded by C59's reference roster (verify-check-diagnostics), which the census does not run (D846)

input-stack-frame-raw-newline-only.why: a module-level pattern every plant loads; it fires on an input-probe finding, and input probing is graded by the security reference gates (C51-C58, verify:security-acceptance, D751), not by the acceptance roster

nearest-matches-not-deduped.why: the nearest-matches diagnosis on a locator that resolved to nothing: every browser plant runs through it and reads the element that answered, never the sentence a miss produces; C13-C22 grade which element answered, C108 grades which web base a file is at home under

oauth2-session-ctx.why: C80 reaches the `if (decl.oauth2)` test and no plant declares an `oauth2` session, so the arm is never entered; whether apiV2 can serve one is the first question a plant here would have to answer

ok-ignores-no-verdict.why: 102 plants run through the report verdict and every run they read completed; `noVerdictReason` is non-null only for an aborted or inconclusive run, which no plant produces

open-model-agents-per-arrival.why: same eight plants, same curve-only grading — a fresh TCP handshake per arrival moves the reported latency and not the arrival count

open-model-back-to-fetch.why: eight perf plants run open-model arrivals through this line and grade the arrival curve the server recorded; none grades the reported latency, which is where the unpinned fetch path shows (p50 36 ms against 0 ms in the same process)

open-model-maxsockets-bounded.why: a module-level constant every plant loads; its effect — arrivals queuing inside the generator past 50 concurrent sockets and reporting the wait as service time — needs a workload that holds more than 50 connections open at once, and the perf plants are deliberately small (25 rps against a 50 ms path)

passing-assertion-gets-annotated.why: the nearest-matches diagnosis on a locator that resolved to nothing: every browser plant runs through it and reads the element that answered, never the sentence a miss produces; C13-C22 grade which element answered, C108 grades which web base a file is at home under

request-headers-not-lowercased.why: reached by C80's security assertion; the rule that reads the lowercased header (`authenticated-response-cacheable`) is graded by the security reference gates (D751), and C80's own known answer is 200-with versus 401-without

reserved-scheme-passes-through.why: 82 plants pass their base URL through the reserved-scheme guard and every one is `http://`; a fixture whose `api` is a misspelt `tflw://` scheme, graded on the one-sentence refusal, is the plant

saturation-cpu-arm-never-fires.why: the generator self-diagnosis (`saturated`) is computed on every load run and lands in results.json; seven or eight perf plants read the arrival curve and never the diagnosis, and none of them drives its own generator hard enough to trip either arm — a deliberately saturating fixture is possible and expensive on a shared box

saturation-flips-a-gradable-threshold.why: reached by C3; the verdict-collapse it inverts needs a saturated generator, which no plant produces, so the merged `ok` is only ever computed over scenarios that all measured cleanly

saturation-ignores-the-min-window.why: the generator self-diagnosis (`saturated`) is computed on every load run and lands in results.json; seven or eight perf plants read the arrival curve and never the diagnosis, and none of them drives its own generator hard enough to trip either arm — a deliberately saturating fixture is possible and expensive on a shared box

saturation-lag-arm-never-fires.why: the generator self-diagnosis (`saturated`) is computed on every load run and lands in results.json; seven or eight perf plants read the arrival curve and never the diagnosis, and none of them drives its own generator hard enough to trip either arm — a deliberately saturating fixture is possible and expensive on a shared box

session-source-lines.why: C80 establishes a session and grades 200-with versus 401-without; the report `source` lines of the session steps — which document they were rendered from — are read by nothing

speculative-line-replaces-the-final-diag.why: 32 browser plants poll through this deadline and every one resolves inside ~3 s against a fast app, so a poll that gave up at the speculative mark is indistinguishable from one that kept going; a fixture with an element that appears at 5 s would tell them apart

spelled-out-duration-not-a-number.why: same 37 plants, same numeric operands; `expect duration is less than 2 seconds` — the spelled-out form the unwrap exists for — appears in no fixture

suggestion-offered-without-its-ambiguity.why: the nearest-matches diagnosis on a locator that resolved to nothing: every browser plant runs through it and reads the element that answered, never the sentence a miss produces; C13-C22 grade which element answered, C108 grades which web base a file is at home under

text-diagnosis-offers-structural-css-pat.why: the nearest-matches diagnosis on a locator that resolved to nothing: every browser plant runs through it and reads the element that answered, never the sentence a miss produces; C13-C22 grade which element answered, C108 grades which web base a file is at home under

threshold-scope-falls-back-to-the-whole-.why: the endpoint lookup behind `threshold … for "label"`: all eight workload plants (C3, C44–C50) evaluate thresholds through this line and none of them states a scoped one — C49's `verdict.tflw` grades an unscoped p95 and an unscoped error rate, so `scope === undefined` on every evaluation and the fallback to the whole histogram is the path the plant already takes; the only scoped threshold in either corpus is `perf/tflw/checkout-burst.tflw`, which the acceptance roster does not run. Not a candidate in the previous census — the `m172a` entry postdates it — so `M190`'s is its first measurement and this its first verdict. A plant would need a two-endpoint workload whose scoped p95 differs from the whole's

tls-facts-absent-counts-as-applicable.why: reached by C80's security assertion over plaintext; the TLS rules' applicability is graded by the security reference gates (D751), and C80 asserts nothing about the scan

ui-wait-ignores-its-own-budget.why: fifteen plants run the locator form of `wait until` and all of them are satisfied well inside both the step budget and the env budget, so which budget bounded the poll is never observed; the known answers are about what the wait waited FOR

ungradable-threshold-passes.why: eight workload plants evaluate thresholds through this line and every one of them has successful iterations, so `actual === null` is never the case; C49 grades a red and a green threshold on a path that answers — a workload whose every request fails is the plant

unnamed-arm-dropped-for-every-kind.why: the nearest-matches diagnosis on a locator that resolved to nothing: every browser plant runs through it and reads the element that answered, never the sentence a miss produces; C13-C22 grade which element answered, C108 grades which web base a file is at home under

verdict-not-restamped-after-splice.why: reached only by C3 (`--workers 4` splices a merged report); the stale verdict needs an abort arriving at the splice, and no plant aborts a run — a plant that induces `inconclusive` under `--workers` is the missing fixture

wait-reader-picks-the-subject-over-the-r.why: the `wait until status of request to "…"` form: fifteen plants reach the reader and none of their fixtures writes the network-ref form, so the ordering of the two reads is never exercised; a browser fixture with `wait until … of request to` is the plant

wait-until-diagnosis-dropped.why: the nearest-matches diagnosis on a locator that resolved to nothing: every browser plant runs through it and reads the element that answered, never the sentence a miss produces; C13-C22 grade which element answered, C108 grades which web base a file is at home under
